name: giga-marketplace
description: Plug-and-play skills for agentic engineering, research and planning, Copilot CLI and npm maintenance — plus setup-ai, a bootstrap wizard that vendors customizable agent-workspace templates (rules, hooks, review agents, workflows, tech writing) into any repo.

plugins.name: agent-architecture
plugins.description: Design, build and audit multi-agent systems — agent-as-function orchestrators with filesystem artifact handoff, fractal orchestrator architectures, workflow evals, guided agent-family creation, and autonomous optimization loops.

plugins.name: research-planning
plugins.description: Research and planning working skills — iterative multi-round web research, deep research that leaves a measured evidence record, mapping your own unknown unknowns before a long task, and task-graph planning for multi-file work.

plugins.name: copilot-cli
plugins.description: Skills for GitHub Copilot CLI — debug log analysis, extension development with @github/copilot-sdk, system-prompt patching, and writing large files without CLI timeouts.

plugins.name: npm-maintenance
plugins.description: Move npm dependencies safely — fix npm audit advisories, routine minor/patch refreshes, and release-age cooldown install failures.

plugins.name: setup-ai
plugins.description: Bootstrap an agent workspace in any repo — one wizard skill that asks what to set up, checks and installs prerequisites, then vendors and fills in template packs (working rules, hooks, review agents, dev workflows, Jira filing and QA with the jira-mcp server, GitHub issue filing, tech writing), merges settings and .mcp.json, and installs third-party skills via npx skills. Also reports status and removes packs cleanly. Requires Node.js.
